class.name: TickObject
class.brief_description: Synchronizes properties of a node through a [TickNetwork].

method.name: _apply_interpolated_state
method.description: Called on peers that interpolate this object, with the interpolated value of each declared property. If not overridden, the properties are set on the root node.

method.name: _collect_input
method.description: Called on the controller, once per tick, to write the input of this tick in [param input]. Not called during rewinds: the stored inputs are used.

method.name: _process_tick
method.description: Advances the object by one tick. [param input] holds the controller's input; it's empty (size 0) when no input is available. Called on the server and on the predicting client, also during rewinds (see [method is_rewinding]).

method.name: _setup_sync
method.description: Called once, before the object is registered in the network. Declare the synchronized properties here with [method declare_var].

method.name: declare_var
method.description: Declares a property of the root node to synchronize, encoded with [param codec]. Nested properties use the property path syntax, for example [code]"transform:origin"[/code]. Only valid inside [method _setup_sync].

method.name: get_declared_vars
method.description: Returns the names of the declared properties.

method.name: get_net_id
method.description: Returns the network id of this object, or 0 if it isn't synchronized yet.

method.name: get_network
method.description: Returns the [TickNetwork] this object is registered in.

method.name: get_root_node
method.description: Returns the node whose properties are synchronized.

method.name: is_rewinding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the network simulates again past frames. Use it to skip side effects.

members.member: Peer whose input drives this object: 1 for the server (NPCs, the host), or a client id. It can't change while the object is registered.
Path to the [TickNetwork]. If empty, the first [TickNetwork] ancestor is used, or else the first one in the scene.
Path to the node whose properties are synchronized.
